test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the grammatically correct sentence.**

options.text: It was a hectic day for Susan with a lot of purchases and a couple of meetings.
It was a hectic day for Susan with the lot of purchase and a couple of meetings.
It was a hectic day for Susan with the lot of purchase and an couple of meetings.
It was the hectic day for Susan with a lot of purchase and the couple of meetings.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**It was a hectic day for Susan with a lot of purchases and a couple of meetings.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is grammatically correct because it uses the correct article "**a**" before "**lot of purchases**" and "**couple of meetings**".
 
• Subject: "**It**" - This is a pronoun that serves as the subject of the sentence.
 
• Verb: "**was**" - This is the linking verb that connects the subject to the subject complement.
 
• Subject Complement: "**a hectic day for Susan with a lot of purchases and a couple of meetings**" - This is a noun phrase that provides more information about the subject "**It**." It describes what kind of day it was for Susan.
 
• So, the sentence is grammatically correct and effectively conveys that Susan had a busy and eventful day with numerous purchases and a few meetings.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: Incorrect grammar due to the use of "**the**" before "**lot of purchase**".
 
• Option 3: Incorrect grammar due to the use of "**an**" before "**couple of meetings**".
 
• Option 4: Incorrect grammar due to the use of "**the**" before "**hectic day**" and "**couple of meetings**".
